Rule.name: Amlak-Rule-BeforeRule-Hoop
Rule.Description: BeforeOperation rule for Hoop Web Services connector. GETs the current account, merges groups for Add/Remove Entitlement, sets status only for Enable/Disable, and bootstraps Create (POST) when Add Entitlement targets a missing Hoop user (404).

Argument.name: application
Argument.Description: The application object that owns this endpoint.

Argument.name: requestEndPoint
Argument.Description: The current request endpoint being processed.

Argument.name: oldResponseMap
Argument.Description: Response map from previous endpoint executions.

Argument.name: restClient
Argument.Description: REST client used by the Web Services connector.

Argument.name: provisioningPlan
Argument.Description: Provisioning plan for the current operation, if any.

Argument.name: requestEndPoint
Argument.Description: Updated endpoint with rewritten jsonBody (and Create switch on Add+404).
